properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): a role component that the deployment runs as 8 replicas across 2 zones is reported as a single point of failure. The rule is topology over one node per role. The only thing that silences it is an explicit statement (`medium: library/data`), and no statement exists anywhere in the schema for "this runs N copies". So the only exit is an acknowledgement, which records the opposite of the truth
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-29, item I10 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29.

① OBSERVED (friction #33, reflow2 0.74.0): "A single point of failure is reported on a ROLE. design-host and cold-archive are flagged, because the model has one component per role and cannot say '8 instances across 2 zones'." Cost: 2 standing defects that only a person's acknowledgement clears. Expected: a way to state redundancy. NOT affected: library/data-medium components, which are exempt.

② PRECEDENT, searched in both designs:
- dec:operational-spof (accepted, 2026-07-19): candidates are things that operate, "because the suggested fix is add_redundancy".
- dec:service-spof-accepted and dec:graph-spof-accepted: reflow2's own GENUINE single instances, accepted by decision.
- None covers a component that already IS redundant.

③ CANDIDATES:
- (a) the designer missed an existing replica, count or redundancy field;
- (b) the detector reads such a field and the designer did not set it;
- (c) the model has no multiplicity, and the rule cannot know;
- (d) the deployment layer holds counts that the rule does not read.

④⑤ MEASURED by reading the code and the schema at 0.74.0:
- heal.rs (single_point_of_failure) and structure.rs (is_single_point_of_failure_in, couples_only_as_a_library, interface_is_foundation): the candidate filter reads node TYPE and Interface.medium only. No property anywhere is read for redundancy.
- schema/operate.yaml: DEPLOYED_TO carries {status}, INCLUDES carries {as_checksum}, REQUIRES_RESOURCE carries {criticality}, Environment carries {env_type, location}, Resource has no amount.
- schema/structure.yaml: Component has kind, level, tier, location, status and provenance, and no count.
So (a), (b) and (d) are refuted. There is nowhere to write "8 instances" that any code could read.

⑥ CLASS: "silence has to be EARNED by an explicit statement" (the library exemption's own doctrine), yet for redundancy no statement exists to earn it with. The fix the finding suggests (`add_redundancy`) is the state the design is already in. An acknowledgement then reads as "accepted risk", which is FALSE for a replicated role. The deployment layer is the missing half: counts and placement have no home either (see the I23 finding on cmp:operate). A cause at the class (multiplicity is sayable, and the rule reads it) would have prevented both flags.

⑦⑧ OWED: a pinning test that fails today (a component whose declared multiplicity is at least 2, or whose deployment spans at least 2 placements, is not a candidate), and the fix. Both wait on the modelling decision in dec:idea-a-component-says-how-many-copies-run-and-where.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED:
- Whether multiplicity belongs on the Component (a role property), on the deployment edge (a fact about one environment), or both. The same role can be single in staging and replicated in production.
- Whether zone diversity, not just the count, should be what clears the rule. Two copies on one host are not redundancy.
